description: This file contains utility functions and class definitions for building and managing agent flows in a workflow system, including variable resolution, node dependency analysis, execution management, and branching logic.

classes.name: IWaitingNode
classes.description: Represents a node waiting for inputs, including received inputs, expected inputs, and conditional groups.

classes.name: INodeQueue
classes.description: Represents a queue item for node processing, including node ID, data, and inputs.

classes.name: IProcessNodeOutputsParams
classes.description: Parameters for processing node outputs, including node info, graph, nodes, edges, and execution context.

classes.name: IAgentFlowRuntime
classes.description: Runtime context for agent flow, including state, chat history, and form data.

classes.name: IExecuteNodeParams
classes.description: Parameters for executing a node, including node info, graph, chat history, app data source, and other context.

classes.name: IExecuteAgentFlowParams
classes.description: Parameters for executing an agent flow, extending flow execution parameters with incoming input.

methods.name: addExecution
methods.description: Creates and saves a new execution record in the database with given agent flow data.

methods.name: updateExecution
methods.description: Updates an existing execution record in the database with new data.

methods.name: resolveVariables
methods.description: Resolves variables within node data, chat history, form, and other context, replacing placeholders with actual values.

methods.name: getNodeInputConnections
methods.description: Retrieves and sorts input connections for a specific node based on workflow edges.

methods.name: setupNodeDependencies
methods.description: Analyzes node input connections and sets up expected inputs and conditional groups.

methods.name: findConditionParent
methods.description: Finds the parent condition node for a given node, if any.

methods.name: hasReceivedRequiredInputs
methods.description: Checks if a node has received all required inputs, including conditional groups.

methods.name: determineNodesToIgnore
methods.description: Determines which nodes should be ignored based on the output conditions of decision nodes.

methods.name: processNodeOutputs
methods.description: Processes the output of a node, handling branching, conditional logic, and updating execution state.
